Notes from the all-hands:
Leadership spent the first twenty minutes celebrating a metric that quietly went back down the following week, which is generally how these things go, but morale was high so nobody mentioned it. The main takeaway was that the roadmap is not changing, except for the three things that are changing, which apparently do not count as changes because they were always going to happen eventually, just maybe not this quarter, and definitely not in the order we originally planned, but the spirit of the plan remains intact and that is what matters most going forward.
Q&A ran long because someone asked about the reorg and got an answer that used the word "synergy" four times without actually saying anything, so we scheduled a follow-up meeting to clarify the follow-up meeting from last month, and honestly at this point the calendar invite has more information in it than the meeting itself, but at least the snacks were genuinely good, so overall a solid use of an hour.
